tests.unique_reason: This test checks that new level values produce NaN in MultiIndex reindexing, a distinct behavior.
tests.valid_reason: Documentation implies NaN for missing values in level reindexing similar to default row/column behavior.

tests.unique_reason: No other test specifically checks that new column labels produce NaN-filled columns.
tests.valid_reason: Documentation examples show NaN for new columns (e.g., 'user_agent' column gets NaN).

tests.unique_reason: No other test verifies that reindex always returns a new DataFrame object rather than a view.
tests.valid_reason: Documentation states 'A new object is produced unless the new index is equivalent to the current one and copy=False' and copy parameter description confirms always returns new object.

tests.unique_reason: This test specifically checks that pre-existing NaN values are not filled by method, a distinct behavior.
